spot1.method: x: tape (23.5 cm, operator); y, yaw: case top-face outline fitted to ZED edges with the calibrated ZED (fit_pc_edges.py, frames folded/parked, top z 0.012-0.018 m -> x 0.2335-0.2375); operator tape y unreliable (2.2 cm off)

spot2.method: case top-face outline fitted to ZED edges with the calibrated ZED (fit_pc_edges.py, top z 0.015 m; 0.012 gives x 0.2125), readerframe frames; PC slid 2 cm toward the arms from spot1

spot2_repeat.method: case top-face outline fitted to ZED edges with the calibrated ZED (fit_pc_edges.py, top z 0.015 m; 0.012 gives x 0.2125), readerframe frames; PC slid 2 cm toward the arms from spot1; same placement re-imaged (PC not moved), edge fit 0.215, 0.3785, 2.0 deg

spot2_repeat2.method: case top-face outline fitted to ZED edges with the calibrated ZED (fit_pc_edges.py, top z 0.015 m; 0.012 gives x 0.2125), readerframe frames; PC slid 2 cm toward the arms from spot1; same PC placement re-imaged again (PC not moved, reader moved slightly), edge fit 0.215, 0.3785, 2.0 deg
